excerpt: Calculate Abu Dhabi net rental yield using collected rent, owner expenses, total acquisition cost and tenancy terms.
introduction:
Net rental yield compares a property's annual operating income with the capital used to acquire it. For an Abu Dhabi apartment, begin with comparable lease evidence, allow for vacancy and subtract owner-paid service charges, management, repairs and insurance. Divide the result by the full acquisition cost.

This is a planning estimate, not a guaranteed return. The figures below are examples; use current unit-specific documents and verify the tenancy rules in force when making a decision.
takeaways: Net operating income is expected rent less vacancy and owner-paid operating costs.
Use the price plus acquisition and setup costs as the denominator when comparing properties.
Separate mortgage, tax and eventual sale costs, and check current Abu Dhabi rental rules.

sections.heading: How is net rental yield calculated?
sections.body:
Estimate annual rent using recent signed leases for genuinely similar apartments. Subtract a vacancy or uncollected-rent allowance and the owner's operating expenses. The result is net operating income, or NOI. Divide NOI by the purchase price plus acquisition and initial setup costs, then multiply by 100.

Gross yield often divides annual rent by the purchase price alone. It can be an initial screen, but it omits vacancy and expenses and does not show the owner's cash after a mortgage. Use the same definitions for every property.

The [Al Reem and Al Raha family area guide](/journal/al-reem-island-vs-al-raha-beach-for-family-living) provides location context, but a specific building and lease determine the relevant inputs.

sections.heading: Work through the example
sections.body:
Assume a price of AED 1,000,000 and AED 50,000 acquisition and setup costs, giving AED 1,050,000 total capital. Assume AED 90,000 annual rent, AED 7,500 vacancy allowance, AED 12,000 service charges, AED 4,500 management, AED 3,500 repairs and AED 1,000 insurance.

Net operating income is AED 90,000 minus AED 28,500 of deductions, or AED 61,500. Dividing by AED 1,050,000 gives approximately 5.86%. These example numbers show how annual income and costs combine in a yield calculation.

The chart shows the rent, deductions and income as parts of one calculation. It excludes mortgage payments, tax, capital gains or losses and sale costs.

sections.heading: Choose rent and vacancy assumptions
sections.body:
Seek recent signed leases for similar units in the same building where available. Compare bedrooms, area, condition, parking, furnishing, included services and the lease period. An asking rent is not proof of the signed or collected amount. Allow for the time between tenants and any work needed before reletting.

ADREC announced a [temporary rental increase measure on 3 June 2026](https://adrec.gov.ae/en/news/press-release-26---rental-freeze-update), describing a 0% annual increase for the duration of the measure and reference to the last registered Tawtheeq contract. Confirm whether it remains in force and how it applies to the particular lease; do not assume a standard annual increase.

ADREC's [document verification service](https://adrec.gov.ae/en/verify-document) includes tenancy contracts. Check current registration and verification requirements for the agreement.

sections.heading: Check expenses and acquisition cost
sections.body:
Request the unit's current service-charge statement, calculation basis, payment dates and any arrears. Add the owner's property management, maintenance, insurance and utilities paid while vacant. Confirm the lease allocation and avoid counting the same expense twice.

DARI's [sale registration service](https://services.dari.ae/consumer-services/registration-of-sale-and-purchase-of-land-and-real-estate/) lists the current service process and charges. Ask for the buyer's actual share, brokerage, finance and setup costs in writing. The [Abu Dhabi purchase cost guide](/journal/total-cost-of-buying-an-apartment-in-abu-dhabi) explains the budget.

For an unfinished building, identify which charges are estimates and when a final budget will be available. A current statement is not a promise that future costs will remain unchanged.

sections.heading: Separate finance and eventual sale
sections.body:
Prepare a second schedule showing rent collected, operating costs, loan payments and outstanding principal. Net operating yield is calculated before finance and is not the same as cash flow after bank repayments. Request current lender terms and test a change in rate, income or valuation.

At sale, estimate proceeds using a range of prices, selling costs and the remaining loan. A one-year yield does not include capital gains or losses or guarantee an immediate sale. Seek recent completed sales of comparable units where available.

The [Abu Dhabi 2027 market outlook](/journal/abu-dhabi-property-market-outlook) provides dated aggregate context, not a return for an individual apartment.

sections.heading: Stress-test and document the inputs
sections.body:
Recalculate with a longer vacancy, lower rent and an unexpected repair or higher charge. Ask whether the property remains affordable while loan or service-charge payments continue. Keep a separate cash reserve.

Record the source and date of every input. A signed lease, current charge statement and written transaction quote are more useful than a single headline yield. If a number is uncertain, show a range and update it when better evidence is available.

sections.heading: Use the same period for each property
sections.body:
Compare each candidate over the same twelve months and record when the unit can legally be occupied. If one apartment is furnished, include the cost of buying and replacing its furniture; if another needs work before letting, include that work and the time required. Check whether parking and utilities are included in the rent.

Ask what a management quote covers and whether applicable tax is included. Keep the calculation and its supporting documents together so that a change in lease, charge or purchase price can be updated consistently. Do not compare one property's gross rent with another property's net income.

sections.heading: Apply the method to a current unit
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Abu Dhabi project collection](/projects?emirate=Abu%20Dhabi) and [contact Aliyas](/contact) with your budget and intended tenant. Ask which units are currently available and request their plans, prices and charges.

Verify the ownership right, current official requirements and comparable lease evidence before investing.
